integrity: Analytic argument uses strict sine secants, cycle Fourier spectrum, rank-one inertia and topological degree; finite numerical checks are illustrative, not proof. No independent validation or external certification has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Applies to unweighted finite cycles only. The result establishes an open set with at least three regular inverse images above threshold, not an exact global preimage count. No orbit-convergence claim for supercritical coupling. Equivalent historical priority under other terminology remains possible.
title: Complete topological reversibility boundary for discrete Huygens rings
